title: Basecamp Palisade RV Resort

services.name: Extended Stay Program
services.desc: Once you spend time in beautiful Palisade, Colorado, you know you’ll want to stay longer! Palisade Basecamp offers limited extended stay opportunities. The extended stay program offers a beautiful mild winter atmosphere for the snowbirds, or a longer summer for those who want to spend more time in the area exploring. Western Colorado is a hub for food, wine, and outdoor adventures and Palisade Basecamp makes the perfect extended stay spot, perfectly situated along the Colorado River in Palisade’s wine and fruit country. services.name: campground cabin
services.desc: We offer stunning views of Colorado’s fruit and wine country from all of our RV and trailer campsites with a variety of options to suit every need, including pull-thru or back-in sites. All RV sites including full hookups: 20-, 30- and 50-amp electrical service, water, sewer, Wi-Fi, grass and picnic tables. Tents are prohibited at our RV sites, but we offer a beautiful tent camping area along the Colorado River. Maximum 6 guests per site, 2 adults are included in the base rate. Additional person charge for additional adults, children (under the age of 18) are free. 2 vehicles are allowed per site (one inhabited RV/vehicle and one passenger vehicle).
